execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Post" (
  "createdAt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
  "id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
